stem.text: The removal of a plant cell wall by enzyme digestion leaves an intact membrane-bound structure called a protoplast.
Which statement explains why protoplasts are easily damaged?

A.text: Mitochondria stop producing ATP to maintain membrane integrity.

B.text: Net movement of water is no longer limited by turgor.

C.text: Secretory vesicles are unable to fuse with the cell surface membrane.

D.text: The shape of the cell structures is changed by the loss of cell shape.
